patch_description: Builds on the highest-scoring prior design (single shared RY parameter across all 8 qubits, single shared RZ global-phase parameter, and a single shared ZZ coupling parameter driving a nearest-neighbor ring + long-range "opposite" shell + skip-2 shell). To further enrich the reachable Hilbert space without increasing the trainable-parameter budget, an additional XX ring (nearest-neighbor, wrap-around) is interleaved right after the ZZ shells, reusing the exact same "zz_ring" parameter name. This orthogonal two-qubit interaction (X-basis coupling vs. Z-basis coupling) has been shown to boost circuit expressivity for a fixed parameter count, which should help separate the hardest validation group (worst-group margin) while keeping n_distinct_params at 3 — matching or improving on the best prior score. The overall structure (pre-rotation → forward CNOT ladder → global phase → parametrized entangling shells → backward CNOT ladder → global phase) is preserved for training stability and fast convergence.
